Class OrderBLL

java.lang.Object
business_logic.OrderBLL
public class OrderBLL extends Object
Business Logic Layer class for handling order related operations.

Manages the process of placing orders, calculating the total price, and filling the combo boxes with client and product data.

  • Method Details

    • placeOrder

      public static void placeOrder(String client, String productName, String nrOfProducts, String price)
      Places an order .

      Validates the quantity and product availability, calculates the total price, saves the order to the database, and updates the product stock. Shows error message if the stock is insufficient, if the quantity of product is not a valid number or another error occurred.

      Parameters:
      client - is the name of the client placing the order.
      productName - is the name of the product being ordered.
      nrOfProducts - is the number of products that were ordered.
      price - is the unit price of the ordered product.

    • updateFinalPrice

      public static void updateFinalPrice(JTextField priceField, JTextField quantityField, JTextField finalPriceField)
      Updates the final price field in the GUI based on the unit price and quantity.

      The final price field is cleared if inputs are invalid.

      Parameters:
      priceField - is the JTextField containing the unit price of the ordered product.
      quantityField - is the JTextField containing the quantity of product.
      finalPriceField - is the JTextField to display the calculated final price (quantity x unit price).
